results.name: Leather Armchair (gamedev)
results.description: A chair is a piece of furniture with a raised surface supported by legs, commonly used to seat a single person. Chairs are supported most often by four legs and have a back however, a chair can have three legs or can have a different shape. Chairs are made of a wide variety of materials, ranging from wood to metal to synthetic material (e.g. plastic), and they may be padded or upholstered in various colors and fabrics, either just on the seat (as with some dining room chairs) or on the entire chair. Chairs are used in a number of rooms in homes (e.g. in living rooms, dining rooms, and dens), in schools and offices (with desks), and in various other workplaces.

results.name: Star Wars Lambda Imperial Shuttle
results.description:
The Lambda in flight mode. Not totally canon, but I think it's OK. Useful as a background prop anyways. Has enough details. Wings and wing-guns kan be rotated (pivoted and parented), aft gun can be rotated and ramp can be lowered (also pivoted).

The front part of the cockpit floor can also be moved forward underneath the seats to make the entrance wider for persons to actually walk down the ramp without hitting their heads. You'll figure it out :)

Scale is somewhat smaller, about 6m in length and approx 12m height (wings unfolded).
The ride comes with a cockpit with a seating arrangement for a six member crew.

The scale of things, and a Shuttle Pilot holding an IDCA-22 Datapad (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/star-wars-idca-22-datapad-9667eee0cb2a44e388d7454313ced06a):
![](https://tegnemaskin.no/gfx/sw-lambda%2Bpilot-3d-05.jpg)

Off we go:
![](https://tegnemaskin.no/gfx/sw-lambda%2Bpilot-3d-12.jpg)

More renders over at Artstation: https://www.artstation.com/artwork/8wVYO6

results.name: Volga GAZ 24-03 Ambulance
results.description:
The GAZ-24 "Volga" is a car manufactured by the Gorkovsky Avtomobilny Zavod (GAZ, Gorky Automobile Plant) from 1970 to 1985 as a generation of its Volga marque. Belgian-assembled re-badge models were sold as the Scaldia-Volga M24 and M24D for the Western European market.

Standard engine was aluminium-block overhead valve 2,445 cc (149.2 cu in) ZMZ-24D inline-four producing 95 hp (71 kW; 96 PS) with one twin-choke carburetor. Only a four-speed manual transmission with floor-mounted shifter was offered (though GAZ did prototype an automatic, a column-shift manual, and a three-speed manual with overdrive).

The medical modification of the new "Volga" appeared in 1975, three years after the release of the "station wagon". Externally, the GAZ-24-03 ambulances did not differ from the base model. The small cabin allowed one patient to be transported on a retractable stretcher and two accompanying persons on the side seats.

results.name: Heinkel He 162D Volksjäger
results.description:
Heinkel He 162 A-2 Spatz (Sparrow)
Single engine, single seat, jet fighter, green and silver, BMW OO3E Turbojet engine, ca. 1945.

The German jet fighter that is now synonymous with the project that inspired it, the Volksjäger or People's Fighter program, first flew on December 6, 1944. The Reich Air Ministry issued specifications for the program on September 10, 1944, challenging manufacturer's to design, build, and fly, as quickly as possible, an "emergency, lightweight fighter" powered by a single BMW 003 engine. The specifications also spelled out these key requirements: the new design must be easily mass-produced with the least amount of strategic materials such as steel and aluminum, and flight performance must exceed that of piston-engined fighters.

More info at https://airandspace.si.edu/collection-objects/heinkel-he-162-2-spatz-sparrow/nasm_A196003

Note: it is recommended to use **first person** mode while entering the cockpit view.
